_doc: APPEND-ONLY public record of numbers MUNTIN published and got wrong. Distinct from data/cost-revisions.json, which logs 10,294 SOURCE revisions — someone else's number changing. This file logs OUR errors. Rendered to /cost-index/corrections/ by scripts/build-corrections-page.mjs; validated by scripts/check-corrections-ledger.mjs. Entries are never edited or removed: a correction that can be deleted is not a record.

_fieldContract.id: COR-NNN, assigned in order, never reused
_fieldContract.correct: what is true, with the file and path that proves it
_fieldContract.brokeOn: the date the statement became false (often NOT the date it was published)
_fieldContract.why: the mechanism, in one sentence a reader can check — not an apology
_fieldContract.gate: the check script that now prevents recurrence. REQUIRED. An entry with no gate is a confession, not a correction; the gate is what makes the record evidence that the machine improved.
_fieldContract.surface: the URL or file path a reader can open
_fieldContract.status: corrected | pending — pending means the mechanism shipped before the prose was rewritten, which is stated openly rather than held back

corrections.published: Ground beef, wholesale reference $393.06 per pound (cost-index/feed.json, reference.priceUsd, source "bls", basis "wholesale", dated 2026-06-01).
corrections.correct: That figure is the BLS ground-beef INDEX value, not a price. It is not $393.06 per pound and never was. The measured wholesale level for that slug was $5.51/lb (usda-lmr, 2026-06-10) and was published correctly the whole time in cost-index/index.json — the two feeds disagreed by 71x.
corrections.why: Every observation carried its own basis in data/cost-index.json — all five BLS points are labelled basis:"index" — but the series renderer discarded the per-observation basis and stamped the whole file with the ingredient's newest LEVEL basis, which is genuinely "wholesale". A basis is a property of an observation; the code treated it as a property of a file.
corrections.gateNote: The gate existed and was green. It cross-referenced at the INGREDIENT level, so one true statement about ground beef concealed five false statements about observations. It now resolves every rendered dollar back to its own observation, refuses any figure sourced to a series that publishes indices, and independently flags a 20x step between the reconstructed backfill and the live capture. It also ships a --mutation-proof mode that reintroduces each leak class and asserts the gate goes red, because a gate that has never been shown to fail is not evidence.

corrections.published: The July 2026 dispatch's #the-record section: band pooled coverage 0.772 across 32 items and 4,588 scored steps; direction calls 0.536 over 1,859 scored calls; a revision ledger of 2,080 entries.
corrections.correct: Against the files the post names, those figures now read 0.767, 75 items, 79,086 scored steps, 0.506, 34,029 scored calls, and 10,294 entries.
corrections.why: Static prose cited moving files. Every figure was true on publication day and went false the next time a builder ran. The two annotations in that post that are still true are the two whose value is structural — a verdict and an empty list — which is the whole diagnosis in one line.
corrections.gateNote: New. It resolves every <!-- src: --> citation against the file it names and fails on a false claim, and it defines an anchored grammar — edition:<asOf> <path> = <value> — that resolves against the append-only frozen edition spine instead of a live file. A dated post can now cite something that does not move.
corrections.pendingNote: The gate shipped 2026-08-07; the prose rewrite is still owed and is tracked as HD-04/HD-05 in docs/handoff/honesty-debt/honesty-debt.json. Publishing this entry before the rewrite is deliberate — the record should show what is known, when it was known, on the day it was known.

corrections.published: A cite drawer in the July 2026 dispatch: "both rebuilt from committed data on every refresh and re-checked in CI. Every number in this section traces to one of them."
corrections.correct: No CI check re-checked those citations. The claim was false when written.
corrections.why: A statement about the company's own machinery was written from intent rather than from the machinery. It is the most serious item on this ledger — a false claim about a gate is worse than a stale number, because it invites a reader to trust everything else on the page.
corrections.gateNote: The claim is now true for the classes this gate covers. It is wired into check-all, which runs inside the Cloudflare deploy, so a false citation blocks a deploy rather than reaching a reader.
corrections.pendingNote: The gate exists; the drawer's numbers are corrected under COR-002.

corrections.published: llms.txt and es/llms.txt: 'The Muntin Cost Index publishes weekly wholesale reference prices' / 'publica semanalmente precios mayoristas de referencia'.
corrections.correct: The Index dispatch has been MONTHLY since 2026-07-09. Both files now say monthly / mensualmente.
corrections.why: The cadence changed by decision, and the decision was recorded in the workflow header that is its source of truth — but llms.txt is generated by a builder with the old wording hard-coded, and nothing connected the two. The file written specifically so machines describe the company accurately was the one describing it wrongly, in both languages, for 29 days.
corrections.gateNote: The assertion was added to the gate that already owns dispatch cadence rather than as a new script — a new gate is a new obligation in a one-person company. It scans both locales. Verified to have teeth by reintroducing the old wording, which turned the gate red and named the line.
